translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Santu Espíritu shamushgan
Jesucristo cawarimushganpita ganchis semänata Pentecostés fiesta junagmi Jesucristuman lapan yäracogcuna juc wayicho shuntacäyargan.
Saycho jamaraycäyaptinmi elagpita wiyacämorgan fiyupa gaparar shucucuy vientunöpis ciëlupita shamuycashgan. Sayga chargan paycuna shuntaraycäyashgan wayimanmi.
Saymi say wayicho shuntaraycagcuna ricayargan mechëro sindiycagnöla ninacuna paycunaman chagta.
Say hörami Santu Espirituta lapan chasquiyargan. Santu Espíritu parlasiptinmi paycuna parlayargan imaypis mana parlayashgan idiömacunapa.
Say wisanmi may-say nacioncunapitapis Israel runacuna Jerusalenman chäyargan Pentecostés fiestapä.

Saymi say wayicho shucucuy vientuno gaparashganta wiyayashpan runacuna sayman aywayargan ima päsashgantapis ricayänanpä. Saychömi lapanpis wiyayargan may-saypitapis shamog runacunapa idiömancunacho parlaycäyagta. Sayno parlaycäyashganta wiyarmi cushicuyargan.
Sayno cushicuyashpanmi niyargan: “Lapan cay parlaycagcunaga ¿manacu Galilea runacuna caycäyan?
Galilea runacuna caycarga ¿imanöpatä paycuna yachacuyash nogansipa idiömansicho parlayänanpä?
Shamushcansi Partiapita, Mediapita, Elampita, Mesopotamiapita, Judeapita, Capadociapita, Pontupita, Asiapita,

Frigiapita, Panfiliapita, Egiptupita, Libiacho cag Cirenipa cercancunapita y Romapitapis. Waquinninsega yurishgansipita-pasami Israel runacuna caycansi. Y waquinninsinami mana Israel runacuna caycarpis Diosta chasquicushcansi Israel runana canansipä.
Cretapitapis, Arabiapitapis caycho shuntacashmi caycansi. May-saypita cashgapis quiquinsipa idiömansichömi Tayta Diosninsipa wilacuyninta parlapaycämansi.”
Saymi fiyupa cushicur quiquinpura parlayargan: “¿Imatä päsaycan?”
Sayno niyaptinmi burlacuyashpan waquin runacuna niyargan: “Caycunaga shincash carmi imata parlayashgantapis musyayansu.”
Jesucristupa wilacuyninta Pedro wilacushgan
Sayno niyaptinmi apóstol mayincunawan jamaraycashganpita ichircur Pedro nergan: “Jerusalencho y may-saychöpis tag Israel mayëcuna, shumag wiyayämay.
Manami gamcuna yarpäyashgayquinösu nogacuna shincash caycäyä.
Saypa trucanga Tayta Diosninsipa profëtan Joel guelgashgannölami canan cumplicaycan.
Paymi Tayta Diosninsi nishgancunata cayno guelgargan:

content.text: ‘Tiempo chämuptinnami Santu Espirituta cachamushä lapan chasquicamagcunaman.
Santu Espirituta chasquicurnami nogapa wilacuynëta wilacuyanga olgu suriquicuna y warmi suriquicunapis.
Saynölami auquincunata sueñuynincunacho ima päsananpä cagcunatapis musyasishä.
Say wisanmi munashgäta ruragcunaman Santu Espirituta cachamushäpä.
Cay pasachöpis runacuna segaypa wanusinacogtami ricayanquipä.
May-saychöpis rupaptinmi cay pasa goshtaywan sapash caycagta ricayanquipä.
Say chämushgan junagnöga manami imaypis yapay canganasu.
Sayno cananpä captinpis nogata manacamag cäga salvashmi cayangapä.’ ”

content: Tayta Diosninsipa profëtan Joel sayno guelgashganta yarparcasirmi Pedro nergan: “Israel mayëcuna, cay parlamushgäcunata shumag wiyayämay. Nazaret marcapita cag Jesusga Tayta Diosninsi cachamushgan runami cargan. Sayno cashgantaga Tayta Diosninsi musyasimashcansi milagrucunata ruraptinmi.

Sayno caycaptinpis gamcunami Jesusta prësu sarircur jusasapa runacunapa maquinman entregayashcanqui crucificaypa wanusinanpä. Sayno entregaptiquimi Tayta Diosninsi palabrancho guelgarashgancuna cumpliyargan.
Sayno wanusiptinpis manami wanushgalanchöga usharashgasu. Saypa trucanga Tayta Diosninsimi payta cawarisimush.
Sayno cawarimunanpä cashganpitami rey David cayno guelgargan:

content.text: Saynöpis manami cacharinquipäsu pamparashgalächo ayä ismunanta.

content: Sayno David guelgashganta wilapayta ushasquirmi Pedro nergan: “Israel mayëcuna, sayno guelgar unay rey David manami quiquinpäsu guelgargan, sinöga Jesucristupämi. Musyansimi David wanur maynincho pamparashgantapis.
Tayta Diosninsipa profëtanmi rey Davidga cargan. Paytami Tayta Diosninsi nergan castanpita juc runa yurir imayyagpis mandag rey cananpä cashganta.

Saymi Davidga quiquinpä guelgananpa trucan say yurinanpä cagpita guelgargan. Payga salvamagninsi Jesucristumi caycan. Jesucristo cawarimushganta ricaycagnöpis paypämi David guelgargan Hadischo almanta Tayta Dios mana cacharinanpä cashganta y cuerpun pamparashgalancho mana quëdananpä cashgantapis.
David guelgashgannölami Jesucristuta Tayta Diosninsi cawarisimush. Cawarircamur puriptinmi lapä ricayashcä.

Cawarircasimurnami Jesusta derëcha cag lädunman Tayta Diosninsi jamasish lapanpäpis munayyog cananpä. Saypitanami Tayta Diosninsi promitishgan Santu Espirituta nogacunaman cachamush. Sayno cachamush captinmi juc idiömacunapa parlasiyämashganta canan wiyaycäyanqui.

Shumag tantyacuyay. Davidga manami wanushganpita cawarircamur ciëluman wisashgasu. Señorninsi Jesucristumi isanga wanushganpita cawarircamur ciëluman wisash. Ciëluman wisarcur Tayta Diospa naupanman jamacunanpä cashganpitami David cayno guelgargan:

content.text: “Jamacamuy derëcha cag naupäman lapan contrayquicunata vincishgäyag.” ’ ”

content: Saypita Pedro yapay nergan: “Israel mayëcuna, shumag tantyacuyay. Gamcuna Jesusta cruzcho wanusish captiquipis Tayta Diosninsimi payta churash maquincho sararämänansipä y salvamagninsi cananpäpis.”
Sayno niptinmi runacuna fiyupa laquicuyashpan tapuyargan Pedruta y waquin cag apostolcunatapis: “Sayno captenga ¿imatatä rurayäman?” niyashpan.
Saynami Pedro nergan: “Tayta Diosninsi jusayquicunata perdonayäshunayquipä jusalicuyashgayquita cacharir Jesucristupa jutincho bautizacuyay. Saynöpami gamcunapis Santu Espirituta chasquicuyanquipä.
Santu Espiritutaga manami nogacunalapäsu Tayta Diosninsi cachamush. Saypa trucanga cachamush gamcunapä, suriquicunapä y Jesucristuta chasquicogcunapäga may-saycho taptinpis lapanpämi.”
Pedro mastapis tantyasergan: “¡Waquin runacuna jusalicur cawayaptinpis gamcunaga ama jusalicuyaysu!”
Punta cag yäracogcuna imano cawayashganpis
Pedro nishganta chasquicogcuna lapan say junag bautizacuyargan. Say bautizacogcunaga cayargan quimsa waranganömi (3,000).
Paycunami imaypis shuntacäyag apostolcuna yachasiyashgancunata yachacuyänanpä, Santa Cënata upuyänanpä y Tayta Diosninsita manacuyänanpäpis.
Apostolcuna milagrucunata rurayashganta ricarmi lapan yäracogcuna espantash ricacuyargan.
Paycunaga imaypis shuntacäyashpanmi cashganpita imatapis nistashgan-tupu raquipänacuyag.
Saynömi chacrancunatapis y imaycancunatapis ranticuyag. Say guellaytanami nistäyashgan-tupu aypunacuyag.
Waran waranmi templo patiuman shuntacäyag Tayta Diosta manacuyänanpä. Wayincunachöpis shuntacäyashpan Santa Cënata upurcur cushishlami micuytapis micuyag.
Paycunaga imaypis Tayta Diosta agradëcicuyag yanapashganpita. Lapan runacunami paycunata respitayag. Saynöpis waran waranmi runacuna Jesucristuta chasquicuyag.

footnotes.text: Tayta Diosninsi ricasishgancunata musyanayquipä liyinqui Hechos 9.7,10; 10.3,10; 12.7; 18.9.
